appearances.snippet: We have, we are now hearing from people who worked in other parts of the hospital saying that their computers were shut down for six hours.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: Episode 363 supplies no outage logs, timestamps, affected-system list, cause, hospital confirmation, or evidence that any interruption altered or concealed Kirk's records.

records.text: Harpole Replays Hospital Door Account
records.speaker: Brian Harpole

appearances.snippet: And and so then, you know, once you get that cut shirt off, shirt cut off and moved out of the way, you know, there's enough medical professionals in there. ... And so I just want to get out of their way. And so I got out of their way and walked out of the room and then stood outside the room and held guard on the outside door of the room so nobody else could come in there.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: Harpole says he left the treatment room after assisting staff and guarded the door to prevent others entering.

records.text: ER Relocated Before Shooting?
records.speaker: Anonymous Timpanogos Hospital source (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: I am told that at some point in the 10 o'clock a.m. hour. ... On September 10th, so to be clear, and this is crucial, over two hours before Charlie was shot, the Timpanogos hospital staff directed everyone who was in the emergency room into a different wing of the hospital.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: An anonymous source alleges Timpanogos moved ER patients to another wing during the 10 a.m. hour on September 10, more than two hours before the shooting.

records.text: 11:30 Patient Shuttle Alleged
records.speaker: Anonymous Timpanogos Hospital source (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: Then after some time at approximately 11 30 a.m. patients were informed that they would be transferred aboard shuttles to Intermountain Hospital. ... That's Utah Valley Hospital. And that's what happened.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: The source says patients were told around 11:30 a.m. that shuttles would take them to Utah Valley Hospital.

records.text: Patients and Files Transferred?
records.speaker: Anonymous Timpanogos Hospital source (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: All of the emergency room patients and all of their files were then transferred to Intermountain.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: The source alleges all ER patients and their files were transferred from Timpanogos to Utah Valley Hospital.

records.text: Hospital Camera Seizure Repeated
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So there's effectively no trail, outside of hospital cameras which have been conveniently seized by Kash Patel's office, of these patients ever having been at Timpanogos Hospital.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: Owens repeats that Kash Patel's office seized hospital-camera footage and treats it as an obstacle to checking the transfer story.

records.text: Transfer Cast as Foreknowledge
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Let's get on that. More tips at CandaceOwens.com because if we are able to prove that this took place beyond a shadow of a doubt with paperwork, then ... I would say foreknowledge of Charlie's assassination can no longer be disputed.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: Owens says documentary confirmation of the pre-shooting patient transfer would establish advance knowledge of Kirk's assassination.

records.text: Separate EHR Systems Repeated
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We had specifically mentioned that the Timpanogos Hospital system—they use a system called Epic—did not speak to Utah Valley's Intermountain Health system. ... So it made it entirely no sense that Charlie's file would appear there, but it was there. And there was no way this person could have made it up because it had Charlie's personal details, even his like home address back in Illinois, which was not available to the public.

links.title: What led here and what followed

records.notes: Owens repeats that the two hospitals' systems did not communicate, yet Kirk's Utah Valley entry included personal details.
